title: solutions-pro-services-weekly-sync-notes-2026-05-05
content:
Weekly sync notes: Solutions Engineering + Pro Services
Date: 2026-05-05
Attendees: Marina Alvarez (owner), Ethan Park, Sofia Martinez, Daniel Wu, Priya Rao, Alex Nguyen (sales), Kate Simmons (customer success)
Absentees: None
----
Agenda:
- Quick round of customer statuses (top 6 active engagements)
- Blockers / escalation items
- Resource needs (infra, PM, SRE)
- Action items and owners
----
Notes by customer:
1) Acme Health (PHI-sensitive, private deployment)
- Current phase: Integration validation + performance tuning on private deployment (VPC).
- Recent progress: Completed data ingest adapter and basic inference pipeline. KV-cache hit rate ~72% on sample traces. Initial latency p95 (32k context) = 210ms using 1xA100 per replica.
- Outstanding tasks: Finalize encryption-in-transit policy w/ customer KMS team; run full e2e throughput test with canary dataset; enable autoscaling policy for burst windows.
- Blockers: KMS key rotation process needs approval from Acme security (ticket JIRA-PS-4821). Also waiting on firewall rules from their networking (expected by 2026-05-07).
- ETA: Integration sign-off targeted 2026-05-21 (depends on KMS approval).
- Owner(s): Marina (overall), Daniel (infra/config), Priya (security compliance)
- Notes/Questions: Confirm whether Acme wants per-request encryption metadata logged (they said yes but need retention policy).
----
2) Nomad Finance (hosted API -> dedicated capacity trial)
- Current phase: Dedicated capacity sizing + throughput validation.
- Recent progress: Baseline traffic replay run completed. Observed 14% cost reduction with batching + model quantization profile 'q8_eco' suggested by Optimize team.
- Outstanding tasks: Finalize commit for dedicated capacity (billing/legal paperwork outstanding), tighten latency SLOs for critical endpoints, run canary with 10% production traffic.
- Blockers: Legal redline on contract (sales) and required IP addendum. Sales to escalate.
- ETA: Canary target 2026-05-12 pending paperwork.
- Owner(s): Ethan (solutions lead), Alex (sales)
----
3) GreenCart (multi-region latency optimization)
- Current phase: Routing policy and cache warmup for EU+NA regions.
- Recent progress: Smart routing rule created to route EU requests to eu-1, fallback to na-1; cache pre-warm script tested with 95% hit for top 50 prompts.
- Outstanding tasks: Deploy auto-fallback policy in case eu-1 backfills (need SRE runbook).
- Blockers: None major; request SRE to document rollback steps (ticket JIRA-PS-4890).
- ETA: Rollout planned 2026-05-08.
- Owner(s): Sofia (lead), SRE contact: Omar Lin
----
4) Vertex Retail (embedding migration + reranking)
- Current phase: Embedding model migration (v1.2 -> v2.0) and reranking pipeline tuning.
- Recent progress: Migration script validated on small shard; embedding dimensionality change requires downstream index rebuild. Reranker params improved MAP@10 by +3.2% on eval set.
- Outstanding tasks: Coordinate index rebuild window with customer (expected window 3 hours), verify warm start for dedupe service.
- Blockers: Index rebuild tooling needs additional throttling controls. Engineering to propose change.
- ETA: 2026-05-19 for full migration if rebuild window approved.
- Owner(s): Daniel (eng), Priya (PM)
----
5) Orion Media (streaming/chat use-case)
- Current phase: Function calling + streaming QA.
- Recent progress: Streaming endpoint validated for multi-turn context; function-calling schema agreed (see Confluence doc). Minor bug: early EOF on long streams fixed in patch (PR #214).
- Outstanding tasks: Run load test at 2k concurrent streams to validate handler sizing, finalize cost estimates for customer.
- Blockers: None critical. Waiting on final approval for PR from release-engineering.
- ETA: 2026-05-11 for load test.
- Owner(s): Sofia, Release Eng reviewer: Jordan Hicks
----
6) Atlas Corp (proof-of-concept, offline reranking)
- Current phase: POC evaluation, offline batching experiments.
- Recent progress: Batch throughput looks promising; quantization to int8 reduces memory by 45% with small quality regression (~1%).
- Outstanding tasks: Customer wants a comparison report vs their baseline (deliverable due 2026-05-09).
- Blockers: Need evaluation dataset from Atlas (requested 2026-04-28, follow-up required).
- Owner: Priya
----
Cross-cutting items / team-wide notes:
- Resource asks: Two additional infra hours for private deployment validation (Marina/Daniel). SRE to allocate a 3-hour window next week for performance testing.
- Security/compliance: Priya to schedule final compliance call with Acme and Security on 2026-05-06.
- Tooling/dev: Need small enhancement in index rebuild tool (throttling) — Daniel to scope and file GH issue.
- Observability: Add per-route token-cost dashboard for Nomad Finance (Ethan + Observability team).
----
Blockers / Escalations (summary):
- Acme KMS approval (blocked on customer security) -> escalate via Kate (CS) to Acme CISO.
- Nomad Finance contract paperwork -> Sales escalation (Alex).
- Index rebuild throttling -> Engineering (Daniel) to deliver design by 2026-05-08.
----
Action items (owners & due dates):
- Priya: Schedule Acme security call (due 2026-05-06)
- Daniel: Draft GH issue and design for index rebuild throttling (due 2026-05-08)
- Ethan: Coordinate dedicated capacity billing ask with sales/legal for Nomad (due 2026-05-07)
- Marina: Reserve SRE perf-testing window and confirm infra hours (due 2026-05-06)
- Sofia: Kick off 2k concurrent stream load test for Orion Media (due 2026-05-11)
- All: Update linked artifacts (Confluence / JIRA) with final test results when complete
----
Open questions / notes to follow up:
- Do we want to add a hard SLA template for Dedicated trials? (Ethan to propose)
- Confirm logging retention policy for Acme (Marina + Priya)
- Should we schedule a dedicated rollcall for index-rebuild related customers next week? (Daniel to propose cadence)
----
Next sync: 2026-05-12 (same time)
Minutes prepared by: Marina Alvarez
Comments: Draft — please add updates to Confluence page and JIRA tickets before next sync.
